dependency.semantic_contract: Guarded-hybrid dependent behavior through the shared PKG-20 uint32 map adapter. The helper walks a lower-bound-shaped tree, retains the latest node whose key is greater than or equal to the query, and accepts the result only when that retained candidate exactly equals the query. A present exact key is therefore not a robust hit when a greater right child replaces it before the final guard; the wrapper returns the anchor/null path. The wrapper does not define another map type or add successor tolerance.
